description: Clarkson’s first revival run moves from classical mythology and Cold War history through astronomy, Scottish landmarks and natural history, establishing a question ladder in which almost any corner of general knowledge can become suddenly expensive.

s01e01.description: Mythology supplies the episode’s first memorable identity as a goddess of victory enters the question ladder. It is an appropriately grand opening for Clarkson’s revival: ancient knowledge, modern nerves and absolutely no safe subject area.

s01e02.description: A biblical turn of phrase gives this episode its wonderfully sleepy title, while the quiz keeps doing the opposite. Familiar words become traps, obscure knowledge suddenly matters, and Clarkson discovers that being host does not automatically make one useful.

s01e03.description: Cold War geography provides the standout image as Checkpoint Charlie appears among an eclectic run of questions. History, popular culture and deceptively simple general knowledge collide in the usual Millionaire manner: politely, then all at once.

s01e04.description: The Mediterranean supplies the episode’s geographical detour with the Balearic Islands. What looks like a pleasant mental holiday quickly becomes another reminder that Millionaire can turn maps, names and everyday knowledge into surprisingly expensive uncertainties.

s01e05.description: Astronomy takes the spotlight with the heliocentric view of the universe. A single scientific adjective gives the episode its identity while the surrounding ladder ranges freely through the sort of knowledge everyone vaguely remembers until four answers appear.

s01e06.description: A Scottish landmark beside one of the world’s most famous lochs becomes the episode’s defining destination. The question set wanders through history and culture while Clarkson treats geographical certainty as the optional extra it so often is.

s01e07.description: A sure-footed mountain goat becomes the oddly perfect mascot for an episode built around intellectual footing. The questions hop between subjects with similar agility, while contestants discover that recognition and certainty are very different creatures.
